sanitizer_execution: Approved local execution outside tracing sandbox; LSan requires thread inspection. No option disabled. Existing Linux stage11_globals_stack is included in the 19 selected suites.
sanitizer_abi_limit: RTTI-off SDK: vptr checking unavailable; supported address/undefined checks and leaks enabled.
implementation: Source-only stream. Existing generic method declaration lookup shared with compiler-owned completion; no language grammar/IR/Runtime ABI/allocator/codec additions.
limitations: Writes stage a complete buffer copy; repeated small writes can be quadratic.
Reads/seeks allocate state; numeric reads encode zero to obtain width.
Native Windows/macOS and big-endian hosts not executed.
Physical multi-GiB/i64 growth and u32 write-prefix overflow not dynamically allocated; guards source-audited.
